summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K containing its Q2 2026 earnings report. The filing discloses net sales of SEK 52.7 billion (down 6% YoY), adjusted gross margin of 48.4%, and net income of SEK 4.1 billion. It notes a strong net cash position of SEK 59.8 billion and SEK 8.2 billion returned to shareholders via dividends and share repurchases. No M&A, strategic review, activist, delisting, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine quarterly earnings release, not a special situation.
